guard/30338.htm.text: Guard Melville: Welcome to the most fabulous village in the kingdom! There was a time when the village was terribly ruined by the aftermath of war, but thanks to the Lord s active restoration project, the villagers are regaining their livelihood. Well then, have a nice rest! And stay out of trouble!

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.
